density_reference: Begemann et al. 1997, ApJ 476, 199, section 2.2: assumed compact amorphous density, not the measured porous sample density. https://hitran.org/data/Aerosols/Aerosols%20data%20from%20previous%20HITRAN/Aerosols-2016/papers/begemann_al2o3_1997.pdf
material_assumption: Exploratory amorphous-alumina optical compilation of Kitzmann and Heng 2018, combining Begemann 1997 and Koike 1995. Temperature-independent optical constants and compact density are assumptions. Crystal phase, porosity, thermal annealing and temperature dependence require separate comparisons before atmosphere adoption.
size_distribution_assumption: Single 0.1-micron radius for an optical control; not a grain-growth or settling prediction.
